solana_brand.teal_note: The brand page lists only purple and green. A cyan/teal and magenta (#00C2FF, #DC1FFF) appear in older Solana gradients; I could not verify them on a current page: [Unverified]. Event art (Accelerate 2026) uses purple/teal/green per the solana-symbol-history file

solana_brand.logo: Three identical parallelograms; assets: logotype, logomark, wordmark, vertical lockup, Foundation logotype; Drive pack linked from page
rules: Do not add effects (shadows, outlines, blur)
Do not change design or scale proportions
Do not recolor or reduce contrast
Do not use the mark as an image frame
Do not distort, skew or rotate
Do not claim or register the marks
Commercial use or anything implying a Solana connection, incl. merchandise, needs explicit written permission (operations@solana.foundation; press@solana.org for media)
usage_advice: Purple #9945FF: the identity colour. Use for UI chrome, the title wash and focus states; it is the 'this is Solana' signal.
Green #14F195: the energy accent. Use for success, positive PnL, confirm buttons, the end of the gradient. Do not use for losses.
Teal/cyan: only as a mid-gradient or event-style accent; [Unverified] as an official colour.
Do not put the real mark on top of the gradient with effects, and do not turn it into a character (the user rejected mascot-izing, see solana-symbol-history file).
A sign-in screen with a 'Connect wallet' control is a platform integration; ask the Foundation if the mark appears in the shipped store art or marketing.

geography: Superteam lists 25+ country chapters on 6+ continents; Nigeria is the only African chapter named (superteam.fun, 8 Oct).

Nigeria ranked 6th in Chainalysis' 2025 Global Crypto Adoption Index, 3rd for DeFi value received; Sub-Saharan Africa adoption +52% to mid-2025 (chainalysis.com, 2025 edition; a 2026 edition was not found).
Solana's Sept 2026 remittance report names Nigeria, Philippines, India, Mexico, Brazil as focus corridors; 1.3B unbanked adults figure (solana.com/news).
South African rand stablecoin ZARSC (Absa-backed, via Supercoin) arrived on Solana in Sept (roundup).
ct-now 5b: Nigerian CT is 'web3 jobs', reply-guy, ambassador and airdrop-to-gig economy, Pidgin, Sapa humour, P2P on-ramp pain, Arewa Crypto Community in Hausa, SuperteamNG builder track.
Colosseum: 9,492 builders in the live event; 80,000+ lifetime (colosseum.com). Country split not published on the pages I read.
Mercuryo: Solana on-ramp volume +89% in 2026 (roundup). No Africa breakdown found.
seeker: First-party claim: '150,000+ Seeker users worldwide' (store.solanamobile.com, 8 Oct). This is users, not verified units shipped or sold.
Price: $500 list, $250 at 50% off through Breakpoint (store, 8 Oct; ct-now 5 Oct).
No independent unit count found. [Unverified] anything above 150,000.

Who buys: [Inference] crypto-natives who value the Seed Vault and the SKR/Seeker Season quests; the visible X behaviour is quest farming, SKR staking and leaderboards (ct-now 5a, 4 Oct notes: 100M SKR earned, 16 apps, 300,691 badges, all from X posts).
SKR: 10B supply, 30% airdrops, 4.93B staked, 16.4% yield (solanamobile.com/skr). Holder count not published.
Android dApp Store: 0% fees; hackathon CLOCK IN $135K pool, deadline 12 Oct 23:59 UTC.
